title: The first reunion
fact: The first ApeFest began on a yacht during Halloween weekend. It brought many BAYC members together in person for the first time.
joke: He kept the boat. It was supposed to be a napkin.

title: Turn it up
fact: ApeFest returned to Pier 17 for four days of programming. Performers included Eminem and Snoop Dogg, alongside other artists.
joke: He packed the ticket. Then packed the shirt he wore to buy the ticket.

title: A global gathering
fact: The first ApeFest outside New York brought the community to Hong Kong. The weekend included the launch of the BAYC × BAPE apparel collaboration.
joke: He bought a patch. Then brought a second jacket, just in case.

title: The European chapter
fact: The first European ApeFest included live performances, the public launch of ApeChain, and a custom BAYC × BMW vehicle reveal.
joke: The postcard weighs nothing. The twelve backup postcards are the problem.

title: A bigger world
fact: The Las Vegas edition featured the Clubhouse announcement, an anime-project reveal, and live performances. The week also coincided with a ComplexCon partnership.
joke: He checked out. The key tag apparently did not.

title: Art, friends, and one full bag
fact: ApeFest 2026 centers on Beeple Studios in Charleston on October 17, with community gatherings and activities across the surrounding weekend.
joke: One night. Six editions of luggage. He still forgot his charger.
